meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 启动后，Claude 会宣布“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”，然后分 7 个阶段组建一个 5 人“对抗小组”，让成员互相攻击对方方案，只留下经得起攻击的意见，最后交给专门的规划模块整理成可执行的计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“adversarial plan”“hostile planning”等关键词，或要求进行严格对抗式规划、暴露薄弱假设与过度设计时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划一下这个新功能。
say.note: Claude 会启动 5 人对抗小组开始审查。

say.text: 对我的方案做 adversarial plan，找出薄弱假设。
say.note: 成员会互相攻击，只留经得起质疑的意见。

say.text: 启动 hostile planning，检查我的计划有没有过度设计。
say.note: 专门揪出过度设计和盲点。

howto.what_en: On loading, Claude announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team that cross-critiques each other's findings, keeps only insights that survive, then hands them to a planner task (ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like "hyperplan", "adversarial plan", "hostile planning", etc., or ask for rigorous adversarial planning to surface weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this new feature.
Run an adversarial plan on my proposal to find weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only surviving insights remain.

say_en.text: Start hostile planning to check my plan for over-engineering.
